test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.**

A remarkable discovery was made by the scientist.

options.text: The scientist made a remarkable discovery.
The discovery made by the scientist was remarkable.
The remarkable scientist made a discovery.
A remarkable discovery is made by the scientist.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The scientist made a remarkable discovery.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the passive voice construction, the emphasis is on the action or the result rather than the doer of the action.
 
• The sentence starts with the receiver of the action ("**A remarkable discovery**") and then introduces the doer ("**by the scientist**").
 
• In the active voice, we shift the focus to the doer of the action, which is "**the scientist**" in this case.
 
• The sentence begins with the subject, followed by the verb and then the object.
 
• **Passive **Voice Structure: Object + be verb + past participle of the main verb + by + agent__
 
• **Active **Voice Structure: __Subject+Verb+Object__
 
• By transforming the sentence into active voice, we make the sentence more straightforward, putting the focus on the scientist as the doer of the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
